faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Half Moon Bay?
faq.answer: Half Moon Bay homeowners typically invest $6,500 to $15,000 for a full window replacement project. This scenic coastal community's homes — many with Pacific Ocean views — require marine-grade window systems that withstand salt air and persistent coastal winds. Oceanfront and bluff-top properties may exceed $20,000. Single window installation starts at approximately $600.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Half Moon Bay?
faq.answer: Yes. Half Moon Bay requires a building permit for window replacements. Coastal properties may also be subject to Coastal Zone permit requirements administered by the San Mateo County Planning and Building Department. Our team manages all permit and coastal compliance applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Half Moon Bay?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Half Moon Bay commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Half Moon Bay?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Half Moon Bay replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Half Moon Bay?
faq.answer: Most Half Moon Bay projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
